svg.text: Q-Pix single-channel loop | selected preamplified architecture
Negative detector charge -> reset-free CSA -> comparator -> held EVENT -> calibrated current replenishment. Arrow symbols are ideal current probes.
Held bit: sample once per cycle
CIN is the external detector capacitance.
Opposing current quantum; no reset switch or resistor across Cf.
Diagnostic coupling aggressor only; no CLK buffer.
FIVE SOURCE-POWER DOMAINS | SERIES FEED + DECOUPLING
Diode bias interfaces; external current seeds remain explicit.
PARAMS | select the code block and press q for the complete unchanged simulator defaults.
GUI defaults: 1 MHz; C_IN=3 pF; Cf=50 fF; 1.8 V. Qualification recipes supply frozen trims and the selected late phases.
Every source, current probe, receiver load and power-feed element is retained. Colored net names connect support interfaces across panels.
